scope: Only completed guard receipts under selfhost/build/phase131 at cutoff. Guard wall sums include wrapper overhead and may overlap; interval unions are reported separately. These are not CPU time, elapsed total research time, agent tokens or monetary cost. CPU3 includes acquisition, clean timings and instrumented profiling; CPU4 is proof/law work, CPU5/6 are separate correctness/investigation lanes. Categories and negative-control intent are transparent command/path classifications, not independent semantic verdicts. Unfinished guards, unguarded metadata/storage/agent work and large target artifacts are excluded.

campaignWindow.scope: Coordinator-specified campaign window. Unrepresented wall includes unguarded metadata/storage work, planning, agent work, communication and gaps; it is not a measurement of model reasoning or token quota.
